pv_html:
Who is responsible

Jordi Cea. Contact: hello@jordicea.xyz.

What data I collect and why

Contact form. Name, email, message and, if you ask for a call, your phone number and preferred time. I use them only to reply to you. Legal basis: your consent, given when you send the form.

Analytics. If you accept analytics cookies, Google Analytics measures anonymised usage (pages visited, approximate location, device). Legal basis: your consent. Without it, no analytics are loaded.

Who receives the data

The site is hosted on Netlify, which also receives form submissions. Analytics are provided by Google (only if you accept). Both may process data outside the EU under the safeguards they publish (for example the EU-US Data Privacy Framework and standard contractual clauses). I do not sell your data or use it for advertising.

How long I keep it

Form messages: while I handle your enquiry and for a reasonable period afterwards (up to 12 months), unless we start working together. Analytics data: for the limited period configured in my analytics account.

Your rights

You can ask to access, correct or delete your data, restrict or object to its processing, request portability and withdraw your consent at any time by writing to hello@jordicea.xyz. You can also complain to your data protection authority (for example the AEPD in Spain or the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens in the Netherlands).

Cookies and local storage

Analytics cookies (_ga, _ga_*) are set only if you accept. The site also stores your choices (theme, cookie consent) in your browser's local storage; these never leave your device. You can change your cookie choice at any time with "Cookie settings" in the footer.
